from datetime import datetime, timezone
from decimal import Decimal
from ledgerly.adjustments import refund_shipping
from ledgerly.models import Payment
from ledgerly import audit
from ledgerly.errors import BillingError

T0 = datetime(2026,1,1,tzinfo=timezone.utc)
def mk(amt="100.00"):
    return Payment("p","i",Decimal(amt),status="captured",created_at=T0,captured_at=T0)

# full refund sets status
p=mk(); refund_shipping(p,Decimal("100.00"),T0); assert p.status=="refunded" and p.refunded_amount==Decimal("100.00")
# idempotency replay on already refunded payment returns same object, no double apply
audit.clear(); p=mk(); r1=refund_shipping(p,Decimal("10.00"),T0,idempotency_key="k1")
r2=refund_shipping(p,Decimal("10.00"),T0,idempotency_key="k1")
assert r1 is p and r2 is p and p.refunded_amount==Decimal("10.00")
assert len(audit.events("shipping_refunded"))==1
# approval
audit.clear(); p=mk("1000.00")
try: refund_shipping(p,Decimal("500.01"),T0); assert False
except BillingError as e: assert e.code=="approval_required"
refund_shipping(p,Decimal("500.00"),T0)  # at threshold ok
refund_shipping(p,Decimal("500.01"),T0,approved_by="mgr")
# over refund
audit.clear(); p=mk("100.00")
try: refund_shipping(p,Decimal("100.01"),T0); assert False
